sample_unit: vignettes (diabetes and hypertension), each with three sequential stages; advice from GenAI and 22 PCPs rated by 3 clinicians

links.outcome: Rated quality of GenAI vs PCP self-management advice, alone
links.effect: GenAI rated higher than PCPs in six of seven dimensions, adjusted mean differences 1.16 to 1.56 points (P<.001); this was standalone advice, not assistive use.
links.quote: It scored significantly higher than PCPs in six of the seven dimensions, with adjusted mean differences ranging from 1.16 to 1.56 points (P<.001).

links.outcome: Readability of GenAI advice compared with PCP advice
links.effect: No significant difference in readability (-0.22, 95% CI -0.54 to 0.11; P=.19); GenAI mean ranked at about the 23rd percentile of PCPs for readability.
links.quote: Readability was the only exception, with no significant difference between GenAI and PCPs (−0.22, 95% CI −0.54 to 0.11; P=.19).

screen.reason: Vignette-based cross-sectional study comparing the quality of chronic disease self-management advice generated by GenAI versus primary care physicians.
